demos.heading: Before you run anything: set up the shell
demos.purpose: DocuMind can answer a tenant's questions from four stores: its own Vector Search index (the ANN tier), the Firestore rung beneath it, or two managed mirrors, Vertex AI RAG Engine and Vertex AI Search. make up pins acme to RAG Engine and zeta to Vertex AI Search so every store the course teaches is exercised. A managed store holds the text of every current version, but not the kit's addresses: its citations come back with ids like acme:acme_497809ff...#rag-532341da71fe, a page of null even for a PDF, and stages.retrieval_backend: rag_engine. This lesson's step 6 needs acme's questions answered from the kit's own index, so point acme at it for the duration and put the pin back at the end. Module 2 compares the four stores; Module 7 studies the mirrors.

steps.subheading: Do it: the pipeline, read from its two files
steps.purpose: The cell reads both workflow files with the standard library and prints each job: what it needs, whether it signs in to Google, who approves it, and every line that runs an eval.
steps.label: bash — run in the operator shell, in the kit (reads the two workflow files; no network)
steps.expected:
documind-dryrun.yml: on push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch
  tier-a              needs -                  signs in to Google: no
      runs python evals/run_eval.py
documind-cd.yml: on workflow_dispatch
  eval-gate           needs -                  signs in to Google: no
      runs python evals/run_eval.py
  release-candidate   needs eval-gate          signs in to Google: yes, only if inputs.path == 'candidate'
      runs make eval-live PROJECT="$PROJECT" REGION="$REGION" API="https://candidate---documind-api-$NUMBER.$REGION.run.app"
  promote             needs release-candidate  signs in to Google: yes, then a person (production reviewers)
  release-clouddeploy needs eval-gate          signs in to Google: yes, only if inputs.path == 'clouddeploy'
      runs python evals/run_eval.py --api-url "$URL"

steps.purpose: A red row has two honest fixes: correct the system that answered, or correct the row against its clause. The quick, dishonest one is to edit the row until the build is green, and this check exists for that edit. The cell moves lk-06's figure from 60 to 120 days, a figure no acme document holds, then runs the line CI runs.
steps.label: bash — run in the operator shell, in the kit (edits one line of your clone on purpose, then runs what CI runs)
steps.expected:
lk-06 now asks for ['120 days']
 evals/golden.jsonl | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)
== eval gate: OFFLINE (no credentials, no cost) ==
  65 golden rows over 3 tenants, 27 documents

  [FAIL] falsifiable
         lk-06: must_contain '120 days' is not in acme's corpus - the row can only fail
  [PASS] anchors
  [PASS] coverage

  1 problem(s). The golden set cannot judge the model until it judges itself.
exit 1
adaptations: The refusal is the observation: the offline gate must exit 1 with its own words for the broken lk-06. Under the demo's set -e the exit stopped the step before the page's echo, step 3's git checkout never ran, and the lane's golden set stayed broken for the next lesson (21 October 2026). Any other exit, or a 1 without those words, fails.

demos.heading: The candidate gate: a revision with no traffic, judged before any user meets it
demos.purpose: Do it: the candidate This is the workflow's check, by hand: /version on the live URL and on the tag URL, both with a token minted for the live one. Do it: the gate on the candidate Now read the report as a release decision: how many thresholds were judged, what the outsider got, and each required row. The candidate has done its job. Removing its tag ends its URL. Deleting .candidate-revision means a stray make promote stops with an error instead of moving traffic to it; lesson 4.4 explains why both are needed.

steps.heading: The candidate gate: a revision with no traffic, judged before any user meets it
steps.label: bash — run in the operator shell, in the kit (a new revision with no traffic; nothing moves for users)
steps.expected:
gcloud run services update documind-api --region asia-south1 --project documind-ai-YOUR-ID --no-traffic --tag candidate \
  --update-env-vars "^|^GENERATOR_MODEL=gemini-3.6-flash|RAG_MODEL_BASE=gemini-3.6-flash|ROUTING=off|MODEL_BACKEND=vertex|ARMOR=off|SEMANTIC_CACHE=off|RETRIEVAL_CURRENT_ONLY=off|RETRIEVAL_GRAPH=off|GRAPH_BACKEND=firestore|SPANNER_INSTANCE=documind-graph|SPANNER_DATABASE=documind" --remove-env-vars GENERATOR_LOCATION
...
>> candidate revision: documind-api-000NN-yyy (deploy/.candidate-revision - make promote moves traffic to it by name)
>> candidate: https://candidate---documind-api-NUMBER.asia-south1.run.app (no traffic; remove with gcloud run services update-traffic documind-api --remove-tags candidate)
CAND=https://candidate---documind-api-NUMBER.asia-south1.run.app
